SELECT timestamp,
log_attributes['res.statusCode'] AS status,log_attributes['req.method'] AS method,log_attributes['operation'] AS operation,
log_attributes['error.code'] AS error_code,
CASE WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['error.message'],'statement timeout')>0 THEN 'statement_timeout' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['error.message'],'acquire')>0 THEN 'pool_acquisition' WHEN positionCaseInsensitive(log_attributes['error.message'],'timeout')>0 THEN 'timeout' ELSE 'other' END AS error_class,
extract(log_attributes['error.raw'],'(57014|DatabaseTimeout|database_timeout|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNRESET)') AS safe_raw_code,
arrayFilter(k->positionCaseInsensitive(k,'error')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(k,'duration')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(k,'time')>0,mapKeys(log_attributes)) AS diagnostic_fields
FROM logs WHERE source='storage_logs' AND toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['res.statusCode'])>=500 ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 8
